purpose: Define the semantic center of the Potato of Life project and a center-out population order so core project meaning remains primary while comparative traditions, research and archive material deepen it from the outside.

semantic_center.label: Potato of Life
semantic_center.meaning: The project-level triune relational whole. This is the conceptual center readers should encounter first.

spatial_center.label: Axis
spatial_center.meaning: The geometric/navigation centerline through the three reader planes. Axis orients the map but does not replace the Potato of Life as the project's semantic whole.

relational_midpoint.label: Cross / relational midpoint
relational_midpoint.meaning: Plane × Axis inside the shared Door; the point where world-facing and vertical orientation are simultaneously legible.

source_center.label: Father/source-facing center
source_center.meaning: Upper field center and upper Door tip; a role/center inside the whole, not the whole itself.

seed_center.label: Son/Seed Junction
seed_center.meaning: Lower field center and lower Door tip; manifestation/passage-facing pivot where burial, rooting or sprouting can begin.

project_definition.short: The Potato of Life is one triune relational whole organized through Source/Father, Manifestation-and-Passage/Son, and living continuity/Spirit; expressed through two overlapping fields, one shared Door, one Axis, and a living Seed→Root→Tree→Fruit→Return cycle.

theological_relations.label: Father / Source
theological_relations.function: origin, House, Root, orientation, holding and Gardener responsibility

theological_relations.label: Son / Manifestation & Passage
theological_relations.function: embodiment, Door, Vessel, expression, suffering, passage and return

theological_relations.label: Spirit / Living Relation
theological_relations.function: breath, circulation, animation, translation and continuity through the relation

project_definition.geometric_grammar: Two complete overlapping fields — Source and Manifestation — generate a shared Door. Axis and Plane cross within that relation.
project_definition.living_grammar: Seed stores possibility; Root carries provenance and nourishment; Door changes state; Spiral changes level through recurrence; Tree differentiates; Mountain integrates; Garden cultivates; Fruit tests consequence; Seed returns.
project_definition.shadow_grammar: Knowledge can become Life or Strife. Unresolved Ash/Roots can grow Tree of Strife toward Wide Road/Swamp; Repair can metabolize residue into Soil/Living Root and reopen Life.

rings.label: Nucleus — The Potato
rings.purpose: What the project is before comparison.
rings.population_rule: Only mature project-canon whole/role definitions belong here.

rings.label: Core Structure
rings.population_rule: Only operators/coordinates necessary to understand the basic relation.

rings.label: Living Metabolism
rings.purpose: How the project grows, fails, repairs and returns.
rings.population_rule: Project-native growth, transformation and consequence operators. External analogues remain outside.

rings.label: Project Domains / Rooms
rings.purpose: Where the project applies and stores its own work.
rings.population_rule: Canonical Rooms own knowledge. Public topics such as Tim, Religion, Philosophy, Science and World are views into these domains.

rings.label: Comparative Mirrors
rings.purpose: External traditions, myths, symbols and models that illuminate or challenge the center.
rings.population_rule: Every comparator must point inward to at least one project node or question and preserve own-tradition meaning first.

rings.label: Archive / Evidence / Deep Research
rings.purpose: Sources, chronology, provenance, recovered material, detailed disputes and specialist atlases.
rings.population_rule: Deep evidence can be vast; it should not control homepage importance merely by volume.

promotion_rules: A comparative node cannot enter Ring 0–2 merely because it resembles a project symbol.
A new project-native operator must solve a recurring structural problem not already handled by an existing operator.
A comparator should identify the Potato node/question it illuminates; otherwise keep it archive-only.
Volume of sources does not determine centrality.
Home should explain Ring 0–1 and point to Ring 2–3; Rings 4–5 belong deeper.
Rooms should default to project-native structure; comparative populations should require an explicit deeper action.
The semantic center is Potato of Life; the spatial center is Axis. Do not collapse these.
anti_redundancy_rules: Do not create a new realm when an existing plane, terrain, regime, organism, threshold or route already models the function.
Do not repeat comparative examples across Home, House, Rooms and Religion; store them in the branch atlas and link inward/outward.
Do not let navigation diagrams become new ontology owners.
Prefer one project-native definition plus many typed external corridors over many near-synonymous project symbols.

crosscutting_lenses.rule: Lenses change how the center is read without creating new Rooms, planes, realms or ownership.

living_project.rule: Center-adjacent metabolisms coordinate existing Rooms and return to the Potato center through Fruit, repair, provenance and embodied consequence.

three_center_population.rule: C_F, O and C_S are typed coordinates/role-slots. Named figures are anchors or comparators by declared function; placement does not assert literal identity between figures or traditions.

placements.role: project-persona anchor for Father / Source / Gardener / Axis / House
placements.boundary: Internal project placement; Jewish/Christian divine names remain tradition-owned and are not aliases for a living person.

placements.role: Christic Door / relational midpoint / Way / threshold
placements.boundary: Christian theological anchor; Jewish messianic and scriptural readings remain separately represented.

placements.role: Twin / Vessel / Seed / witness-facing manifestation center
placements.boundary: Canonical Thomas means Twin; biological-twin-of-Jesus language belongs to later Thomasine traditions, not the canonical New Testament.

three_center_population.rights_guard: The center map is interpretive navigation, not a target list, guilt map, hierarchy of human worth or instruction to act against any person or group.

center_relational_ontology.continuity: Spirit/Ladder/Time carries relation across successive positions; Spiral is the history-bearing recurrence of that movement.
center_relational_ontology.seed_rule: Future Seed is initiated from an actual present/Here state rather than detached abstraction.
center_relational_ontology.anti_collapse: Role, person, tradition, body analogy, symbol, temporal operator and mathematical comparator remain separately typed.
